questions.question: Evaluate $\int (5x^4 + 3x^2 - 2) \, dx$.
questions.explanation:
Apply the power rule: $\int x^n \, dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C$.

$$\int 5x^4 \, dx = 5 \cdot \frac{x^5}{5} = x^5$$
$$\int 3x^2 \, dx = 3 \cdot \frac{x^3}{3} = x^3$$
$$\int -2 \, dx = -2x$$

Total: $x^5 + x^3 - 2x + C$

questions.question: Evaluate $\int (e^x + \frac{1}{x}) \, dx$ for $x > 0$.
questions.explanation:
$$\int e^x \, dx = e^x$$
$$\int \frac{1}{x} \, dx = \ln|x| + C$$

For $x > 0$: $\ln|x| = \ln(x)$.

Total: $e^x + \ln(x) + C$

questions.question: If $F(x) = \int (6x^2 - 4x + 1) \, dx$ and $F(0) = 3$, find $F(1)$.
questions.explanation:
$$F(x) = \int (6x^2 - 4x + 1) \, dx = 2x^3 - 2x^2 + x + C$$

Use $F(0) = 3$:
$$F(0) = 0 - 0 + 0 + C = 3 \Rightarrow C = 3$$

So $F(x) = 2x^3 - 2x^2 + x + 3$.

$$F(1) = 2 - 2 + 1 + 3 = 4$$
